name: low_vol_compression_long_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: When a Nifty50 stock's 30-bar realized vol drops below the 10th percentile of its 250-bar vol distribution AND the stock is above VWAP, a directional explosion is imminent. Vol compression precedes expansion (GARCH clustering). Buying the compression with a tight stop and wide target captures the asymmetric payoff. Edge persists because most vol strategies use daily data; 1-min vol compression is underexplored.

long.confirmation: bar range expands > 1.5 * avg range of last 10 bars

short.confirmation: bar range expands > 1.5 * avg range of last 10 bars

filters.time_filter: no trades first 15 min or last 60 min
filters.trend_filter: trade in direction of EMA(20) vs VWAP alignment

weaknesses: Vol can stay compressed for hours — patience required and many false expansion signals
Direction of expansion is uncertain — using VWAP as bias helps but isn't reliable
250-bar lookback needs ~4 hours of data, so unusable in the first half of the session
prior_art: Volatility compression/expansion — Keltner/Bollinger squeeze concept on 1-min data
notes: Consider using historical vol ratio (HV_short/HV_long) as an alternative compression metric.
